messages:
Amy S: Heads up - customer demo hit a rapid 429 storm during the embeddings import. They hit ~120k tokens in 3 mins and demo died. Need quick triage, they go live tomorrow morning.
Raj P: Thanks Amy. Can you paste the request logs / error snippet? also which route? embeddings or generate?
Amy S: route: /v1/embeddings, tenant: acme-inc (trial), sdk from demo app. Error snippet: 
```
HTTP 429 Too Many Requests
x-request-id: 9a2f-4b5c
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 34
{"error":"rate limit exceeded"}
```
Raj P: Ok looks like per-tenant trial quota + per-route cap kicked in. Trial accounts have a small global token bucket + per-route soft cap.
Luke W: infra-bot: fetch quota state for tenant acme-inc pls
infra-bot: Quota state for tenant acme-inc: global_token_budget=150000, used_last_10m=130000, per_route(\"/v1/embeddings\").burst_left=0, last_burst_ts=2491234400
Sara M: Timeline? when did they start the import?
Amy S: Started at ~2491234300 (about 4 mins ago). They were doing batched uploads from UI - 100 concurrent small requests for faster UX.
Ken T: 100 concurrent on embeddings will kill the token bucket fast. We throttle per-route to avoid noisy neighbor. Two quick options: 1) temporary demo quota bump (manual) 2) reduce concurrency / enable client-side linear backoff + retries in demo app
Raj P: Sales needs a temporary allowance now. If we can bump the tenant global_token_budget by +200k for 1 hour that should buy the demo. Can SRE do a scoped bump?
Luke W: I can apply a safety bump on dedicated trial pool: applying +200000 token budget for tenant acme-inc, duration 3600s - doing now. Will route fallback if other limits triggered.
infra-bot: Quota update request accepted. new_global_token_budget=350000, expires_at=2491238325
Amy S: Thanks! I'll ask them to retry. Quick ask: what else might surface? any per-route caps left?
Ken T: They had per-route burst window exhausted. After bump they still might hit per-route concurrent_inflight cap (default 20). Suggest instructing frontend to batch into larger requests (reduce concurrency) or enable our streaming / cursor import which uses fewer tokens.
Raj P: For long-term POC: propose we add per-route reservation for their tenant on embeddings route (reserve 50k tokens/min) and lower global noise. I'll open a feature request ticket.
Sara M: Noted. Also capture the X-Request-IDs and send logs to SRE for postmortem. Amy, can you forward logs with receipts?
Amy S: Sent logs to #eng-sre and attached the CLI dump. They retried and demo finished after ~2 mins. Customer was nervous but stayed on call.
Luke W: Follow-up actions:
- (SRE) validate no other tenants impacted - I'm checking cluster metrics.
- (DevEx) add small snippet to demo README to recommend concurrency <= 8 for trial accounts.
- (Sales) confirm if they want a longer trial quota or dedicated Dedicated demo pool.
Raj P: I'll ask them and send an official temporary quota confirmation email. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
Ken T: Also recommend we add a clearer 429 payload that suggests next steps (retry-after / explain trial limits) - file a quick UX ticket.
Amy S: Great. Closing this thread for now, will update if anything else pops up.
